Names in this guide: `subagent` is `Agent`, `skill` is `Skill`, and `mcp__papermemory__*` is `mcp__plugin_academic-harness_papermemory__*`. If a tool named below is not in your tool list, say so.

## LaTeX

Compile with `latexmk -pdf` (or `xelatex`/`lualatex` if the document needs them) from Bash; it handles bibtex and biber. In an Academic Harness project prefer `ah_build` so errors map back to units. A clean compile does not mean the page layout is right: render pages (`pdftoppm`) and `Read` the images rather than assuming the log is enough.
